# CONFORMANCE FIXTURE -- a BLANK LINE inside an entry.
# The gate ACCEPTS it (an entry ends at the next column-0 header, never at a gap).
# The MCP's old hand-written parser ended the entry AT THE BLANK LINE and answered
# `emittedBy: {}` -- "no compiler emits this code" -- about a code the bootstrap declares.

E3010 SemanticUnneededCast
	csharp SemanticUnneededCast

	shv2 unneededCast
	doc A cast is redundant: the value already has the destination type.

E5001 CodeEmitterRegisterPressure
	shv2 registerPressure
	doc Out of registers, and no spill placement is forced.
